_comment: AgriPulse India data catalog -- factual source registry.

sources.name: Open-Meteo
sources.payload: Daily climate variables (temperature_2m_max/min, precipitation_sum, relative_humidity_2m_mean, windspeed_10m_max) for monitored Indian districts (catalog/india_regions.json)
sources.coverage: 10 monitored districts; 30 observed + 7 forecast days per run
sources.units: temperature °C, precipitation mm, humidity %, wind km/h

sources.name: Monitored-district reference (India > State/UT > District > Mandi/APMC)
sources.payload: 10 monitored districts with ISO 3166-2:IN State/UT codes, LGD (Local Government Directory) district codes, mandi/APMC names and approximate coordinate anchors
sources.refinement: Coordinates are approximate reference points; production should refine against an official gazetteer / boundary service. Mandi/APMC names only -- codes are withheld until verified against an e-NAM / AGMARKNET mandi master.

sources.name: Local Government Directory (LGD) district codes
sources.payload: Current LGD district codes (Ministry of Panchayati Raj) used as district_code values; monthly refresh on the OGD platform
sources.note: Authoritative district-code source. Older state-portal copies (e.g. Coimbatore 523) use superseded numbering and are not used.

sources.name: Indian commodity/crop metadata
sources.payload: Common Indian commodities by category (cereals, pulses, oilseeds, commercial, horticulture, sugarcane). Metadata only -- no prices.

sources.name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
sources.payload: Mandi-level commodity prices and arrivals (INR per quintal)
sources.units: INR per quintal (100 kg); arrivals in quintals
sources.note: Live feed extension point (src/ingestion/india_market_source.py). e-NAM publishes no public documented REST API and its portal is not scraped; the market-price forecast stays gated until a live feed is configured. No market forecast values are fabricated.

sources.name: AGMARKNET daily APMC price & arrival records (via India Data Portal)
sources.payload: Daily wholesale APMC mandi prices (min/modal/max) and arrival quantities for agricultural commodities, sourced from AGMARKNET (Directorate of Marketing & Inspection, MoAFW) and exposed as a structured CKAN resource on the India Data Portal
sources.units: price_unit: Rs./Quintal, Rs./Unit, Rs./Bundle; arrival_units: Metric Tonnes, Bundle, Nos
sources.note: Ingested by src/ingestion/india_mandi.py via the IDP datastore_search structured endpoint (resource 13f9964a-9398-4d49-a7b8-2f57c2396c48; GODL-India). Real attributed records labelled with source/last-updated/period; missing values stay null; no traded quantity is synthesized. This build commits the monitored-district bounded subset under data/india/demo/.

sources.name: Open Government Data Platform (India)
sources.payload: OGD catalog page for the current daily price of various commodities in various markets/mandis (AGMARKNET), plus other agriculture datasets
sources.note: Attributes the AGMARKNET daily mandi price/arrival catalog; the India Data Portal structured resource listed above is the machine-readable source this product actually reads (data.gov.in file host is not reliably reachable from all sandboxes).

sources.name: India Meteorological Department (IMD) API
sources.payload: Current weather (current_wx), 7-day city forecast (cityforecast), district-wise rainfall (districtrainfall) and district-wise warnings (districtwarning) via the official IMD API portal
sources.units: temperature °C, rainfall mm, wind km/h, humidity %
sources.note: Ingestion is src/ingestion/imd_weather.py. Live access needs registered, IP-bound credentials via env AGRIPULSE_IMD_API_KEY + AGRIPULSE_IMD_TOKEN; without them the module reports not_configured and never fabricates data. Sandbox fixtures (india_weather_fixture_generator.py) are clearly labelled is_fixture=true.

sources.name: DE&S / MoAFW crop Area-Production-Yield (India agricultural production)
sources.payload: District-wise, season-wise (Kharif/Rabi/Summer/Autumn/Winter/Whole Year/Total) crop production statistics since 1997 by State/UT > District > Crop: area (Hectare), production (Tonnes), yield (Tonnes/Hectare). From the Directorate of Economics & Statistics, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (GODL-India).
sources.units: area Hectare, production Tonnes, yield Tonnes/Hectare
sources.note: Ingestion is src/ingestion/india_agriculture.py (Bronze -> Silver -> india_agriculture.parquet). data.gov.in file host is unreachable on some sandboxes; the same GODL dataset is then acquired via the India Data Portal CKAN resource (see module DEFAULT_SOURCE_URL) or a local copy via AGRIPULSE_AGRICULTURE_FILE. district_code is the DE&S code (not LGD). Missing production values from the source are preserved as null -- never fabricated. Crop names are canonicalized 1:1 via catalog/india_crops.json (similar-looking crops are never merged).

gold_lineage.title: India region x date features (weather + observed market block)
gold_lineage.source: Open-Meteo weather + AGMARKNET daily APMC records (via India Data Portal) + catalog/india_regions.json location mapping
gold_lineage.generated_at: runtime -- refreshed every pipeline run in data/india/catalog/gold_lineage.json

gold_lineage.title: India market/commodity/variety price & arrival summary (AGMARKNET)
gold_lineage.source: AGMARKNET daily APMC records (via India Data Portal)
gold_lineage.producer: src/transform/india_silver_to_gold.py (reuses src/transform/mandi_to_gold.py as the single source of truth)
gold_lineage.generated_at: runtime -- refreshed every pipeline run in data/india/catalog/gold_lineage.json

gold_lineage.title: India Location + Crop (+ Date/Year) integrated crop summary
gold_lineage.source: DE&S/MoAFW Area-Production-Yield + AGMARKNET daily APMC + Open-Meteo weather (monitored districts)
gold_lineage.generated_at: runtime -- refreshed every pipeline run in data/india/catalog/gold_lineage.json

gold_lineage.title: India crop-production forecast (one-year-ahead 2023-2024, prototype)
gold_lineage.producer: src/ml/india_forecast.py (strict temporal split; gradient boosting vs naive persistence, selected on validation; prototype status always declared)
gold_lineage.generated_at: runtime -- refreshed every pipeline run; methodology/metrics/limitations in data/india/catalog/india_model_report.json
